en.title: Minimum Shipments Pairing by Warehouse
en.description:
One shipment sends two items from different warehouses, or a single item on its own; find the minimum number of shipments needed to send everything. This problem has the same rules as Amazon45 and keeps its own independent source number.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, and judging.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), and the second line contains n warehouse numbers (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: the two 8s are paired with 2 and 9 respectively, and 7 is shipped alone, 3 in total. Example 2: items from the same warehouse cannot be paired, 2 shipments. Example 3: pair any two items and ship the remaining one alone, 2 shipments.
hints: Let the maximum warehouse frequency be f; the answer is max(f,ceil(n/2)).
